iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: MNI152 coordinates as provided by the data authors, in the MNI152NLin2009cAsym template space. Keles et al. (2024), Methods, Electrode localization: "In addition, we provide electrode locations in MNI152 coordinates, which we also used for visualization on a structural template atlas (Figs. 1d, 2i)." The Figure 1d caption states: "Recording locations across the patients are shown in the template structural atlas MNI152NLin2009cAsym", and the authors' code (gen_figure1d_electrodelocs.py) plots the NWB electrodes table x/y/z on that template. Axes follow MNI convention (x right, y anterior, z superior), in mm. The per-column axis descriptions stored in the NWB electrodes table (e.g. "+x is posterior") are PyNWB defaults and do not describe these values. Electrodes with missing source coordinates are n/a. The authors note that some template-space locations fall in white matter due to misregistration; localisation was confirmed in native space, which is not distributed.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Co-registration of pre-operative MRI with post-operative MRI and/or CT, then normalisation to MNI152 (source: Keles et al. 2024)
